PlannedChange.description:
One stop the print's own G-code plans: an `M600` colour change or an
`M601` pause, where the firmware waits for a person.

color.description:
The colour loaded at it, as `#RRGGBB` in upper case, from the
`;COLOR_CHANGE,T<n>,#RRGGBB` line just before its `M600`; null for an
`M601`, and for an `M600` with no such line.

index.description: Its place among the file's changes, counting from 0 in file order.

kind.description: What it stops the print for.

layer.description:
The first layer printed after it, counting the first as 1: the layer
whose `;Z:` is the change's height.

offset_bytes.description: The byte offset of the first byte of its `M600` or `M601` line.

PlannedChangeKind.description: What a planned change stops the print for.

oneOf.description: An `M600`: the firmware stops so a person can load the next colour.
An `M601`: the firmware pauses until a person resumes it.

PlannedSegment.description: One stretch of the print between its planned changes.

color.description:
Its colour as `#RRGGBB`: segment 0's the file's `filament_colour`, every
later one its change's; null where the file names none.

filament_mm.description: The filament it feeds, in millimetres: the net of its extrusion moves.

segment.description:
Its number: segment 0 runs from the file's start to change 0, and
segment n from change n-1 to change n, or to the file's end.

description: A print's planned changes as the status read answers them.

changes.description: Every change the file plans, in file order.

expected_color.description:
The colour expected at the job's current position, as `#RRGGBB`; null
when the file names none there or the position is unknown.

segments.description: The stretches between them, in file order.

waiting.description:
The index of the change the printer is waiting at now; null when it is
waiting at none.

title: PlannedChanges
